this_title: Al Murray: Why Does Everyone Hate the British Empire? Season 1
introduction: Al Murray: Why Does Everyone Hate the British Empire? is the third Sky HISTORY original series featuring historian and writer Al Murray and his comedic alter ego, The Pub Landlord. In each location, Al pairs up with a local comedian to explore the history of British colonial rule and its legacy. In India, Al is joined by Anuvab Pal; in Jamaica, by Chris Daley; in South Africa by Loyiso Gola; and in Australia, by Kevin Kropinyeri. Together – with local experts and historians - they find out about the origins of British rule, its impact upon each country and how its legacy continues to influence governance, culture, and attitudes.Episode 1 IndiaEpisode 2 JamaicaEpisode 3 South AfricaEpisode 4 Australia[Read on below to find out what happens in each of the episodes.](https://www.history.co.uk/articles/whats-coming-up-on-al-murray-why-does-everyone-hate-the-british-empire)
